resources.string: Let agents control this phone with adb

Pairs adb in the Linux environment with this phone’s Wireless debugging, so agents can install apps, read logs, take screenshots and tap the screen. Needs Android 11 or newer and Wi‑Fi. Everything stays on the phone.
Wireless debugging needs Android 11 or newer.
Finish setting up the Linux environment first.
This offline build cannot download ADB.

1. Tap “Pair this phone”. Developer options opens and a notification appears.
2. Turn on Wireless debugging, then tap “Pair device with pairing code”.
3. Pull down the notifications and type the 6-digit code into the Mobile Harness notification.
After pairing once, tap Connect whenever you turn Wireless debugging back on.
Enter the port shown under “Pair device with pairing code”.
Agents run adb as the shell user on this phone.
Give agents control of this phone?
Agents will be able to install and uninstall apps, grant permissions, change settings, read system logs and tap or type on the screen. Turn this off when you do not need it.
Notifications are off, so use Pair by hand: keep the pairing dialog open in split screen and type its port and code here.
Open Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging.
